name: When is the best time of year to start a custom framing project?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to start a custom framing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ideally, custom framing projects are best initiated during drier months to avoid weather-related delays. In the Bay Area, late spring through early fall typically offers the most favorable conditions with less rain. However, with proper planning and protective measures like temporary coverings, framing can proceed year-round. Starting during less busy seasons might also offer more scheduling flexibility. We assess weather forecasts and site conditions carefully to minimize risks and keep your project on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to start custom framing is generally late spring to early fall in the Bay Area due to drier weather. With planning, it can proceed year-round.
